title: What is awe? On an uncontested definition, conceptual ambiguities, and cultural limitations

verification.verification_notes: Bibliographic details (journal, volume, issue, pages, DOI) cross-checked via the Wikipedia 'Awe' reference list on 2026-09-24. Used for the critique that awe lacks an uncontested definition, that 'vastness' as a necessary criterion is contested, and that cross-cultural knowledge of awe is thin - bounding all universal claims in this dossier.
